decisions.statement: Fixed Issue #1 intake slot IDs are used rather than comment positions.
decisions.rationale: The implementation comment states positions should not be calculated after deletions.

decisions.statement: Issue #2 jobs receive distinct Issue #3 scratchpad comments linked by job ID.
decisions.rationale: Durable handoff and recovery are explicit in the instruction library.

decisions.statement: GitHub token-authored edits require scheduled reconciliation for terminal scratchpad archival.
decisions.rationale: Workflow comment documents event suppression and hourly polling.

invariants.rule: An accepted intake is not proof of completed execution.
An active job-to-pad index entry does not prove the job is pending.
Every worker must record and verify its three-issue handshake before editing a job.
User review decisions and verified artifacts precede terminal success.

failures.case: A GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN edit does not trigger another comment workflow.
failures.recovery: Scheduled or manual reconciliation; verify index and archive.

failures.case: Missing or duplicated pad mappings invalidate the three-issue handshake.
failures.recovery: Reconcile mapping with verified permanent comment IDs rather than guessing.
